images.title: The kitchen of fractions
images.purpose: Give the whole chapter on one picture: a kitchen counter with 9 small panels in the order of the chapter, one for each idea, each drawn simply and countably, for the child to say one idea from each stop.
images.composition: A title, then 3 shelves of the kitchen counter, each carrying 3 small cards, read left to right and top to bottom: same whole, grid, pieces of a whole, equivalent fractions, same denominator, same numerator, fractions greater than 1, references 1 and 1/2, relations.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. At the top centre the title The kitchen of fractions (bold, 44 px, dark #1F2937, about y 55). Below it a kitchen counter of 3 shelves: each shelf is 1 thin grey #6B7280 strip, 1416 px wide and 14 px high (x 20 to 1436) at y 290, 520 and 750, and carries 3 cards that sit on it. Each card is a white rounded rectangle 440 px wide and 190 px high with a thin dark #2B2B2B outline (3 px); card left edges at x 20, 508 and 996, card top edges at y 100 (row 1), 330 (row 2) and 560 (row 3), so each card's bottom edge touches the shelf under it. Every card has its title at the top left (bold, 30 px, dark, 18 px from the left edge, about 30 px from the top edge), a small drawing in the middle (about 95 px high, drawn with thin dark outlines, fills teal #0072B2, amber #E69F00 or reddish purple #CC79A7 only) and a caption at the bottom (26 px, dark, about 170 px from the top edge). Positions below are measured from the card's top left corner. CARD 1 (row 1, left), title Same whole: 2 squares of equal size, each 90 px by 90 px, the left one at x 60 to 150 cut by 1 vertical line into 2 equal halves with the left half teal, the right one at x 250 to 340 cut by 1 vertical and 1 horizontal line into 4 equal squares with the top left square amber, both at y 58 to 148; caption 1/2 and 1/4 of one whole. CARD 2 (row 1, middle), title Fraction of a grid: a grid of 8 columns by 6 rows of squares, each 14 px, 112 px by 84 px (48 squares in all) centred at x 164 to 276, y 62 to 146, with the 6 squares of the first column teal; caption 1/8 of 48 squares is 6. CARD 3 (row 1, right), title Pieces make a whole: 1 bar 360 px by 44 px at x 40 to 400, y 70 to 114, made of exactly 3 pieces side by side: a 180 px piece teal with the white text 1/2, then two 90 px pieces amber each with the dark text 1/4 (24 px); caption 1/2 + 1/4 + 1/4 = 1. CARD 4 (row 2, left), title Equivalent fractions: 2 bars of equal length, each 360 px by 34 px at x 40 to 400, the top at y 62 to 96 cut into 3 equal parts of 120 px with the first part teal, the bottom at y 112 to 146 cut into 6 equal parts of 60 px with the first 2 parts teal; caption 1/3 = 2/6. CARD 5 (row 2, middle), title Same denominator: 2 bars of equal length, each 360 px by 34 px at x 40 to 400, both cut into 3 equal parts of 120 px, the top at y 62 to 96 with 1 part teal, the bottom at y 112 to 146 with 2 parts amber; caption 2/3 > 1/3. CARD 6 (row 2, right), title Same numerator: 2 bars of equal length, each 360 px by 34 px at x 40 to 400, the top at y 62 to 96 cut into 5 equal parts of 72 px with 4 parts teal, the bottom at y 112 to 146 cut into 6 equal parts of 60 px with 4 parts amber; caption 4/5 > 4/6. CARD 7 (row 3, left), title Greater than 1: 1 thin dark number line at y 118 from x 40 to x 400 with exactly 7 ticks, one every 60 px (x 40, 100, 160, 220, 280, 340 and 400): 4 tall ticks (22 px) at x 40, 160, 280 and 400 labelled under the line 0, 1, 2 and 3 (24 px, about y 138) and 3 short ticks (14 px) at x 100, 220 and 340 with no labels; exactly 5 curved teal arrows, each 60 px wide and about 28 px high, from x 40 to x 340, one hop of 1/2 from each tick to the next, and 1 reddish purple dot (16 px) on the line at x 340; caption 5/2 = 2 1/2. CARD 8 (row 3, middle), title Compare with 1 and 1/2: 1 thin dark number line at y 112 from x 30 to x 410 with exactly 4 ticks (24 px tall) at x 40, 130, 220 and 400 labelled under the line 0, 1/2, 1 and 2 (24 px, about y 140), the ticks at 1/2 and 1 reddish purple; exactly 2 dots (16 px) on the line, a teal dot at x 198 and an amber dot at x 280, with the labels 7/8 above the teal dot and 8/6 above the amber dot (26 px, about y 82); caption 7/8 < 8/6. CARD 9 (row 3, right), title Relations: 3 rounded boxes, each 120 px by 52 px at y 74 to 126, at x 10 to 130, 160 to 280 and 310 to 430, with the 2 lines of text (24 px, dark) Father's / sister in the first, Her only / brother in the second and Your / father in the third, and 2 short dark arrows (30 px long, arrowheads pointing right) in the gaps between the boxes; caption His child: brother or sister. In all 3 shelves, 9 cards, 9 titles and 9 drawings. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
more or fewer than 9 cards or 3 shelves, or cards in a different order
any extra decoration such as plates, food photographs or kitchen tools
images.takeaway: Every stop of the chapter on one counter: the same whole, grids, pieces of a whole, equivalent fractions, the same denominator or numerator, fractions past 1, the references 1 and 1/2, and relations.
images.description: A kitchen counter of 3 shelves with 3 small cards on each, nine in all, one simple picture for each idea of the chapter from the same whole to relations.
images.context: Concept image for Chapter Revision: Fractions. It gathers the ideas of the figures in your maths book into one map; every number in a panel comes from the chapter's own revision lines.
images.teaching_notes: Walk the counter in reading order and ask the child to say one idea at each card, then to find one card they would still like to try. Do not add numbers to the panels; the pictures are only reminders.

image_decisions.why: A kitchen counter with one small panel for each idea of the chapter gives the revision a single picture to walk through.
